message: The emulation did finish its checks on design revision 2 without any failures. It reported blocked gaps instead: all eight components still need native IBM implementations, and the two existing systems still need a reference plan. That isn't something we got wrong in the design. Today's generator only has a narrow IBM contract for private object storage, and collection, redaction, OpenSearch, Code Engine and watsonx.ai still need to be built in the product, so I won't change or reduce the board to make the check pass. Nothing has been run against an IBM account, region or real model. Which country must the logs, the search index and the watsonx.ai processing stay in? That answer settles our region choice and which models we can use.
